messages:
deploy-bot: Emergency hotfix request for embeddings-service: image rwinference/embeds:1.3.0-hotfixA. CI green. Requesting expedited canary now.

sre-maya: What are clear rollback triggers? Need p95/p99 and error thresholds.

eng-lead-omar: Short: batching selector bug for tiny payloads. Rollback target: 1.3.0 stable. Triggers: p95 +250ms for 3m or error-rate +1% sustained 2m. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeds-hotfix

release-mgr-ana: Need Eng+SRE+Product signoff. Product?

product-sam: Product ack. Impact small but user visible. Approve fast path. Add note: "Fix tiny-batch latency regression, no model changes."

eng-lead-omar: +1 from eng (codeowner). Suggest canary -> 30% -> 100% if healthy.

deploy-bot: Canary started in eu1: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/1745678901

sre-maya: Canary initial checks OK. After 5m p95 back to baseline.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 30% complete. Monitoring.

sre-maya: 15m after ramp: metrics stable, no memory/CPU issues. No rollback.

deploy-bot: Finalizing rollout: switched to rwinference/embeds:1.3.0-hotfixA, deployment complete. SHA: d4e5f6a7.

release-mgr-ana: Scheduling 2h post-deploy review. Closing thread unless issues arise. :tada:
